title: Robotics & Controls
description: A hardware-first path from embedded firmware through controls, robotics, PCB design, and industrial safety — aimed at energy & automation roles.

sections.title: Embedded Foundations
sections.summary: The firmware layer every robot and controller sits on.

nodes.title: Embedded C / C++
nodes.description: Pointers, memory layout, fixed-width types, and bit manipulation on resource-constrained MCUs.

nodes.title: Microcontrollers & GPIO
nodes.description: Clocks, registers, GPIO, timers, interrupts, and ADC on an MCU like the ESP32 or STM32.

nodes.title: RTOS & Real-Time Tasks
nodes.description: Tasks, scheduling, queues, semaphores, and deterministic timing under FreeRTOS.

nodes.title: Serial Buses — I2C / SPI / UART / CAN
nodes.description: Wire-level framing, addressing, and trade-offs of the buses that connect sensors, drives, and controllers.

sections.title: Controls & PLC
sections.summary: Industrial logic, supervision, and closed-loop control.

nodes.title: PLC & Ladder Logic
nodes.description: Scan cycle, I/O mapping, contacts/coils, timers, and counters on a real PLC.

nodes.title: IEC 61131-3 & Structured Text
nodes.description: The five IEC languages, with Structured Text and Function Blocks for maintainable control code.

nodes.title: HMI / SCADA
nodes.description: Operator screens, tags, alarms, historians, and supervisory data flow.

nodes.title: PID & Closed-Loop Control
nodes.description: Feedback, the PID terms, tuning methods, and stability for motion and process loops.

sections.title: Robotics Systems
sections.summary: Turning controlled actuators into coordinated machines.

nodes.title: Kinematics & Motion
nodes.description: Frames, transforms, forward/inverse kinematics, and trajectory planning.

nodes.title: Motion Control & Drives
nodes.description: Steppers, servos, encoders, and drive tuning for accurate, repeatable motion.

nodes.title: ROS 2 & Middleware
nodes.description: Nodes, topics, services, and the DDS layer that ties a robot's subsystems together.

nodes.title: Machine Vision
nodes.description: Cameras, calibration, detection, and inspection for defect-finding and guidance.

sections.title: PCB & Electronics
sections.summary: Designing the boards the firmware runs on.

nodes.title: Schematic Capture
nodes.description: Symbols, nets, power architecture, and design-rule thinking before any layout.

nodes.title: PCB Layout & Routing
nodes.description: Stackups, footprints, routing, ground planes, and manufacturable layout.

nodes.title: Power & Signal Integrity
nodes.description: Regulator topologies, decoupling, return paths, and EMC-aware design.

sections.title: Safety & Standards
sections.summary: What separates a hobby build from an industrial deployment.

nodes.title: Machine Safety & E-Stop
nodes.description: Risk assessment, safety circuits, performance levels (ISO 13849), and safe-state design.

nodes.title: OT / ICS Cybersecurity
nodes.description: Segmentation, defense-in-depth, and the ISA/IEC 62443 framework for control systems.

nodes.title: Hazardous-Area / Ex
nodes.description: Classified areas, intrinsic safety, and Ex equipment for oil, gas, and chemical sites.
